d: LeBron James delivered a historic performance against the Miami Heat, recording 25 points, 10 rebounds, and a season-high 12 assists to notch his first career triple-double as a member of the Philadelphia 76ers and the 126th of his NBA career. LeBron also posted season highs in both points and assists, shooting an efficient 9-of-15 from the field while knocking down four three-pointers. His all-around performance helped lead the 76ers to a 111-104 victory over Miami, improving Philadelphia's record to 15-4 on the season.
